items.label: Define automatic WORK-to-PLAN return as mandatory.
items.evidenceTarget: Agent entrypoints and delivery contracts state that a WORK room must send its Terminal Handoff to PLAN without user copy/paste.
items.verificationNote: AGENTS.md, docs/domains/flowdoc-global-codex-guidance.md, docs/domains/flowdoc-delivery-operating-model.md, docs/domains/flowdoc-plan-room-orchestration-rules.md, docs/domains/flowdoc-work-type-routing-model.md, docs/domains/agent-and-skill-operating-model.md, and docs/domains/flowdoc-first-delivery-round-plan.md state that Automatic WORK-to-PLAN return is mandatory.

items.label: Define multi-WORK completion queue ordering.
items.evidenceTarget: The orchestration contract supports multiple active WORK rooms and close-together returns through completionQueue ordering.
items.verificationNote: The routing and orchestration documents require multiple active WORK rooms to use completionQueue, returnOrderPolicy, arrivalSequence, duplicate handoff handling, and one queued handoff at a time through acceptanceGate.

items.label: Define manual recovery as recovery only.
items.evidenceTarget: Manual pull or user-bridged handoff is recorded as manual-recovered or return-channel-failed and does not satisfy automatic return.
items.verificationNote: The delivery, routing, orchestration, first-round, global guidance, and agent entrypoint documents state that manual recovery fallback can preserve work but does not satisfy automatic return.

items.label: Route the automatic return contract through agent entrypoints.
items.evidenceTarget: Future FlowDoc rooms read the automatic return and multi-WORK queue rules before opening or accepting real WORK rooms.
items.verificationNote: AGENTS.md and docs/domains/flowdoc-global-codex-guidance.md now route future broad delivery, opened rooms, handoffs, and multi-room dispatches through the mandatory automatic return and completionQueue contract.
